source_instruction: i am looking for a women's socks made up of polyester cotton which is washable in machine. also choose black or semi mint rush green color.
query:
You won’t believe what happened on my walk to the corner bodega this morning! I stopped to say hi to the chonky orange tabby that always hangs out on the fire escape of the brownstone two blocks over, and he actually hopped right down onto the sidewalk to rub against my ankle like we’d been best friends for years. I was so busy cooing at him and digging a spare tuna treat out of my bag that I didn’t notice the guy on a bike swerve to avoid a loose fire hydrant cap until he splashed a whole puddle of leftover rainwater straight up the cuff of my favorite jeans. I had to stand there laughing while the cat just blinked at me like none of it was even his fault, then I grabbed my iced oat milk latte and headed home to change before I remembered I needed to pop on here to ask for something.
Hey, can you help me find women’s socks and hosiery for me? I need pairs that are dry clean only, made of that polyester cotton blend, and I want that one color option I always pick, not anything else. Oh and they need to have reinforced non-slip silicone grips on the bottom too, right? My budget’s no more than 30 dollars total, thanks!

extras.text: reinforced non-slip silicone grips on the bottom
